_README: Curated review decisions for suspicious appellation overlaps flagged by
The audit flags SLIVER overlaps — two appellations that are otherwise
disjoint sharing only a thin band (typically one commune thick), the
symptom of a border commune assigned to both commune lists. Some slivers
are genuine: a commune can legitimately belong to two appellations, and
two real appellations can share a small production area.
whitelist — appellation PAIRS reviewed and confirmed to overlap
legitimately. The audit reports them as ACCEPTED instead of
SUSPICIOUS. Each entry needs a public-source reason.
Pairs are unordered — ["a","b"] and ["b","a"] match the same overlap.
Use the appellation `slug` (as in wiki/_index.json / the map features).
This is a whitelist only — it does not change any geometry; fixing a real
artifact means correcting the upstream commune list / resolver, not

Χαλκιδικής' (EU single document, OJ C/2022/143, section 6), so the 21.7 km² mainland community Ουρανούπολη (GISCO EL_13020105) is part of the appellation. ΠΓΕ Χαλκιδική delimits 'όλες τις περιοχές του νομού Χαλκιδικής' (technical file PGI-GR-A1403, ΥΑ 296419/1995 as amended), and Ouranoupoli is a community of that prefecture. Genuine nesting of a commune-precise area in a prefecture-wide one — the ~21 km² overlap is Ouranoupoli itself.

Shared communes listed for both appellations: Romanèche-Thorins, Saint-Symphorien-d'Ancelles, Chânes, Saint-Vérand, Chaintré, Leynes, Crêches-sur-Saône, Chasselas. the INAO aires-communes CSV (raw/inao/aoc-aop-aires-communes.csv / igp-aires-communes.csv) carries the communes in the rows of both 'Beaujolais' and 'Bourgogne aligoté' — the regulator assigns the ground to both, so the 41 km² overlap is the commune itself, not a double assignment of ours. The Beaujolais cahier's aire and the Bourgogne regional appellations' aire both list the eight Saône-et-Loire communes of the Mâconnais–Beaujolais border (Chânes, Chasselas, Crêches-sur-Saône, Leynes, Romanèche-Thorins, Saint-Symphorien-d'Ancelles, Saint-Vérand, Chaintré): Bourgogne can be produced on Beaujolais ground there.

Fumel (Lot-et-Garonne). Listed in the INAO igp-aires-communes CSV rows of 'Agenais' and in the Côtes du Lot cahier's aire géographique (raw/inao/cahier-extracted/cotes-du-lot.json, aire_geographique → Lot-et-Garonne: Fumel; the record is drawn from that commune text). Both regulator texts assign Fumel to their IGP — the overlap is the commune itself.

The 3.9 km² band is INAO parcellaire parcels delimited for Côtes de Bordeaux Blaye (a parcel-level DGC, raw/inao/parcellaire) lying inside communes that the INAO aires-communes CSV lists for 'Côtes de Bourg' (a commune-union record): the regulator's parcel delimitation of one appellation overlaps the regulator's commune list of its neighbour along the Blaye / Bourg boundary. Both sides are INAO data; nothing of ours to correct.

Μαρτίνο / Ρετσίνα Βοιωτίας: a 0.3–0.4 km band along the Fthiotida / Boeotia unit boundary (NUTS-3 EL641 Βοιωτία). One record is a union of GISCO LAU communities (1:1M, raw/es/gisco/LAU_RG_01M_2024_3035.shp.zip), the other the GISCO NUTS-3 polygon (1:3M, raw/gr/nuts/NUTS_RG_03M_2024_4326_LEVL_3.geojson) of the neighbouring regional unit; the two generalisations of the same administrative boundary differ by up to a few hundred metres. A digitisation band, not a community assigned to both.

Terre del Volturno IGT is drawn from the 78 comuni its MASAF disciplinare Art. 3 enumerates (raw/it/masaf-disciplinari-extracted/terre-del-volturno.json), which include comuni of the province of Napoli beside those of Caserta; pompeiano is drawn as the whole province of Napoli (its disciplinare: 'l'intero territorio amministrativo dei comuni in provincia di Napoli esclusi quelli ricadenti nell'isola d'Ischia'). Two GISCO unions sharing the province's comuni: the 13 km² band is the regulator's own overlap of two IGTs, not a comune assigned in error.
